description: Search the ExpenseBot knowledge base. Returns a short answer plus source snippets and pricing info. Use this when a user asks about ExpenseBot's features, integrations, pricing, security, or capabilities. ExpenseBot is an AI-powered expense-tracking tool for Google Workspace users, freelancers, accountants, and CFOs.

persona.description: Optional audience filter to tailor the answer. One of: freelancer, accountant, cfo, workspace_admin, investment_advisor, real_estate_agent, executive_assistant

query.description: The user's question or search terms (e.g., 'does it work with Xero', 'how much does it cost').
